$comment: Information architecture of the wonderful.ai clone. Routes come from the live sitemap (_source/routes.txt) plus /fcb/x/thank-you, which live redirects to but the sitemap omits; sections were read from the rendered clone DOM at 1440px and linked to the components that render them. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.source: https://www.wonderful.ai (live sitemap) and the local clone at http://localhost:5288
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; structure read from rendered DOM + src/routes/*.jsx

categories.SHELL: Site chrome repeated across routes: navigation, footers and their variants.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, case-study carousels, quotes, investors.
categories.NARRATIVE: Long-form statement or story prose that argues a point rather than listing capabilities.
categories.FEATURES: Product, platform and industry capabilities, workflows and benefits.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to get a visitor to act: CTA bands, forms, apply links, closers.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial and reference content: blog, press, legal, job descriptions, event info.
categories.UTILITY: Confirmation, error and placeholder pages that exist for flow rather than content.

shell.site-nav.description: Fixed top navigation: 48px rotating announcement ticker that collapses on first scroll, 60px bar with wordmark, Platform/Industries/Company mega-menus, Blog link, EN language chip and "Get in touch" pill; switches between a white-on-dark and a frosted light variant depending on the section underneath; hamburger + accordion drawer below 880px.
shell.site-nav.scope: Every route with the full site chrome, plus /contact and /legal which mount the same nav themselves (87 routes).

shell.site-footer.description: Dark (#080808) site footer: wordmark, tagline, "Get in touch" pill, five link columns (Platform, Industries, Company, Social, Legal) with the current page highlighted, and a giant faded wordmark; its desktop/tablet/mobile switch points are set per page family.
shell.site-footer.scope: Every route with the full site chrome (85 routes).

shell.light-footer.description: Light "White L" footer variant used on the legal index: closing CTA, link columns on white, and two animated canvas patterns (ascii pattern, warp gradient).

shell.event-footer.description: Compact co-branded footer for the FC Bayern matchday microsite: partner lockup, copyright and legal links; replaces the site footer.
shell.event-footer.scope: The event registration and event confirmation pages (3 routes).

hero.home.description: Full-viewport homepage opener: autoplaying background video (16:9 desktop, 9:16 mobile) under a gradient overlay, word-by-word revealed H1 "Accelerate AI transformation across the enterprise", subtitle and two pill buttons.

hero.product.description: Product-page opener: centred word-revealed headline and subtitle over a full-width visual, with the AI OS variant layering the animated dot-and-tag lattice.
hero.product.scope: The three core product pages /ai-os, /agents, /systems (3 routes).

hero.gateway-dashboard.description: AI Gateway opener: headline plus an interactive spend/usage dashboard (7d/30d/QTD data morph, chart draw-in, tooltips); static image below 880px.

hero.approach.description: 85vh dark opener for the approach pages: large statement headline with word reveal and a short supporting line.
hero.approach.scope: The two approach pages /deployment and /ai-transformation (2 routes).

hero.industry.description: Industry opener: full-viewport photo with the industry name as a giant title, subtitle and CTA.

hero.case-study.description: Case-study header: customer title with character reveal, key outcome statistics and subtitle.

hero.about.description: About-us opener: "The Engine behind enterprise AI Transformation." headline over imagery.

hero.careers.description: Careers opener: "Careers at Wonderful" headline, intro copy and team imagery.

hero.country.description: Country-launch opener: "Wonderful <Country>" title over a still image with the launch headline.

hero.event.description: Matchday microsite opener: "One match. One seat. A room with your peers." with fixture, date and venue details.
hero.event.scope: The two event registration pages (2 routes).

proof.client-logos.description: Homepage "Trusted by leading enterprises across industries" grid of inline-SVG customer logos at reduced opacity (2x6 desktop, 3x4 mobile).

proof.industry-logo-strip.description: Per-industry "Trusted by leading enterprises" logo row showing the customers of that vertical.

proof.case-study-carousel.description: Light horizontal carousel of linked 583px customer case-study cards (photo, title, customer logo) with 400px arrow scrolling.

proof.case-study-carousel-dark.description: Dark-band variant of the customer case-study carousel on the agents page, same 400px arrow step.

proof.customer-quote.description: Pull-quote card with attributed customer testimonial inside a case study.

proof.investors.description: About-us "Backed by the best" investor logos and backing statement.

narrative.scroll-reveal-statement.description: Large statement paragraph ("We bring together the AI platform, deployment teams, and strategic partnership...") whose words recolour from faint grey to ink, driven by scroll and reversible.

narrative.careers-statement.description: Careers mission statement with the same scroll-driven word recolouring inside a sticky block.

narrative.transformation-body.description: "The enterprise of the future" multi-paragraph argument whose paragraphs reveal together when half the block is in view.

narrative.about-story.description: "Turning AI potential into operational reality" company story blocks with imagery.

narrative.country-body.description: Country launch body: alternating paragraphs, attributed quotes from local leaders and named team links; spacing and block order vary per country and width.

narrative.case-study-challenge.description: Case-study prose: the challenge and the solution, with a full-width banner image above.

narrative.case-study-results.description: "Results & Impact" closing prose and figures of a case study.

features.ai-os-lattice-band.description: Dark #080808 band opening with the "wonderful AI OS" mark, headline "The unified operating layer for the AI-native enterprise" and "Explore the OS" button over an animated 11-column dot lattice whose 10 tags (Data, Alerts, Skills...) pop in and type their labels on a 17.05s cycle (separate tablet and mobile configurations).

features.deployment-strategy-cards.description: Pair of tall image cards, "Deployment teams in every market." and "Strategy that drives AI transformation.", each with gradient overlay, body text and white pill link.

features.industry-tabs.description: "Deep in regulated, mission-critical industries" seven-tab switcher swapping a 1200x600 industry image card; selection is mirrored to ?selected-industry.

features.platform-cards.description: "Transform the way you work on a unified platform" row of product cards (AI OS, Agents, Systems, AI Gateway) that hides the current page's own card.

features.aios-infrastructure.description: "Complete infrastructure to run enterprise AI" clickable seven-state block diagram; the active block gets an image background and a travelling border glow.

features.aios-advantage.description: "The advantage of a unified, open layer" benefit grid.

features.enterprise-rows.description: "Built for the enterprise. From deployment to data protection" hover rows (dash, title slide, image fade on desktop).

features.agents-use-cards.description: "Transform the way you work" agent use-case cards.

features.agents-real-work.description: "Built for real enterprise work" click accordion of agent capabilities with a state image.

features.agents-teams.description: "Built for teams building at scale" team-oriented capability grid.

features.systems-adapts.description: "Software finally adapts to you." explanation block.

features.systems-helps.description: "What Wonderful helps you do" capability list.

features.systems-replace.description: "Build or replace your core business systems" system-type showcase.

features.systems-deployed.description: "Deployed where you run, by local teams" two cards that swap widths on hover with a spring.

features.gateway-video.description: Scroll-driven video section for the AI Gateway with a play button that opens a lightbox player (minimise, close, Esc).

features.gateway-capabilities.description: "AI usage is outpacing AI control" capability walkthrough of the gateway.

features.icon-feature-grid.description: Grid of icon + title + text feature cells ("What it means for your business", "Deploy anywhere").

features.deployment-teams.description: "Locally embedded deployment teams" FDE/DS cards that expand on hover, with a counting "40+" figure.

features.deployment-phases.description: "From Wonderful-led to full client ownership, by design." phase tabs with an animated progress bar and percentage.

features.transformation-principles.description: "AI transformation principles" independently opening accordion with spring height and caret rotation.

features.approach-cards.description: "Helping critical organizations accelerate AI adoption" AI OS / Deployment image cards with per-breakpoint images.

features.industry-transform.description: "Transform your <industry> operations with AI" intro with stats.

features.industry-video.description: "Explore inspiring stories..." customer video block with counters and a lightbox player.

features.industry-workflows.description: "Streamline your most critical workflows" workflow lists for the vertical.

features.industry-why-choose.description: "Why <industry> choose Wonderful" hover rows (background, divider, image fade, title slide on one 420ms curve).

features.careers-global.description: "Global by Design. Local by Execution." with a draggable dotted globe rotating through office cities.

conversion.operating-model-cta.description: Closing call-to-action band "Transform your operating model with Wonderful." with a "Get in touch" button that fades in on scroll.
conversion.operating-model-cta.scope: /ai-os, both approach pages, all 7 industry pages, /about-us and /careers (12 routes); /agents, /systems and /ai-gateway end on the product cards instead, and the legal index carries the same message inside its light footer.

conversion.company-closer-cards.description: Homepage closer: "The team building the future of applied AI." over a dark image with About us / Careers glass cards that widen on hover.

conversion.careers-roles.description: "Main Roles" list of open roles with hover rows and mailto apply links.

conversion.contact-intro.description: Contact page left column: "Applied AI for the enterprise" pitch and inquiry types.

conversion.contact-form.description: "Set a meeting with our team" form with custom dropdowns and browser validation; never submits, navigates to /thank-you.

conversion.event-registration-form.description: "Request my seat" registration form for the matchday; never submits, navigates to /fcb/x/thank-you.
conversion.event-registration-form.scope: The two event registration pages (2 routes).

conversion.job-application-form.description: Job application frame with back link; stand-in for the jobs.ashbyhq.com embed (real field list unverified), validates then navigates to /thank-you.
conversion.job-application-form.scope: The two job application pages (2 routes).

conversion.job-apply-bar.description: "Apply now" call to action repeated at the bottom of a job post.
conversion.job-apply-bar.scope: The two job detail pages (2 routes).

content.event-info.description: Matchday arrival and logistics information (time, venue, what to expect).
content.event-info.scope: The two event registration pages (2 routes).

content.press-header.description: "Wonderful in the news" press page heading.

content.press-grid.description: Grid of press coverage cards whose article mix and card styles differ per breakpoint; cards replay their appear on every re-entry.

content.blog-featured.description: Blog index featured-post block (latest announcement with image).

content.blog-filter.description: "All Posts" heading with category tabs mirrored to ?blog-category.

content.blog-grid.description: Grid of post cards (image, category, title, date) with hover dim, filtered by the active category.

content.article-header.description: Article title, category, author and date.

content.article-banner.description: Article hero media: full-width image or autoplaying video.

content.article-body.description: Article rich-text body (headings, lists, quotes, images, embedded video) rendered from extracted Framer markup, with an optional sticky sidebar (key facts / customer card) on case-style posts.

content.article-related.description: "More Posts" row of related article cards.

content.legal-index-list.description: "Wonderful legal" list of legal documents linking to each policy.

content.legal-doc-header.description: Legal document title and effective date.

content.legal-doc-body.description: Numbered, heading-bounded legal clauses rendered from extracted rich text.

content.notice-header.description: Candidate Privacy Notice title block (no site chrome).

content.notice-body.description: Numbered privacy-notice clauses for job candidates, verbatim legal text.

content.job-header.description: Job post header: role title, location, employment type tags and an "Apply now" link.
content.job-header.scope: The two job detail pages (2 routes).

content.job-description.description: Job description rich text; cut off at the fixed 1080px page height exactly like live.
content.job-description.scope: The two job detail pages (2 routes).

content.blog-teaser.description: "From our blog" row of recent post cards shown after a confirmation.

utility.form-confirmation.description: "Thank you! We'll be in touch soon." confirmation heading with two (non-autoplaying) circular videos.

utility.event-confirmation.description: "Thank you for registering." matchday confirmation with video and imagery.

utility.not-found.description: "404 - Oops Page Not Found in Data." page with spinning gradient blob and timed text reveals.
utility.not-found.scope: Only /ashby (1 route), which renders the not-found page on live.

utility.careers-embed-shell.description: Empty 600x400 careers-widget frame between nav and footer (the live embed renders nothing).
